description: Find cadastral parcels by coordinates or bounding box. Three modes: single point (lat+lng), multiple points (points="lat,lng;lat,lng", max 10), or bounding box (bbox="minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat", max 0.05 degrees per side). Returns matching parcels with FID, municipality and centroid.

bbox.description: Bounding box as "minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat", max 0.05 degrees per side
